disposition_reason: The source has ordered stimulus-decoding accuracies and a recoverable classifier recipe. Exact publication/data/supplement identity, original folds and the complete endpoint matrix remain unbound. The existing nested single-measure component changes selection, weighting and input assumptions; it cannot establish a same-task paper win.

source_paper.title: A data-driven approach to identifying and evaluating connectivity-based neural correlates of conscious visual perception

evidence.locator: Methods: Data-driven quantification of inter-areal coupling; Fitting classifiers; Results and Fig. 3b,c
evidence.supports: Defines the original classification family, 94-person cohort, preprocessing and mean-fold accuracy; reports two named barycenter endpoints.

evidence.locator: classifier and scoring definitions; StratifiedGroupKFold; averaged classification branch, lines 63-100 and 185-291
evidence.supports: Pinned source implements balanced L1 logistic regression, mixed-sigmoid scaling, group CV and unweighted mean test-fold accuracy.
Canonical registration points to the 811.0 MB data.zip; metadata alone does not establish equality to the publication analysis inputs.
Later author release instead lists empirical.zip and model.zip. This requires a deliberate publication-to-input join, not silent version replacement.

evidence.locator: Correction notice, 15 October 2026, supplementary data and HTML corrections
evidence.supports: The supplied final_supplement_AGB.pdf replaced an earlier version; the selected supplement has not been authenticated against that correction.

evidence.locator: Scientific scope; two estimands; required complete inputs
evidence.supports: The implementation is prospective nested evaluation; authentic feature extraction, historical 246-measure identity and corrected supplement remain held.

target.description: Stimulus-pair decoding across source region pairs, relevance conditions and onset/offset periods; supplementary relevance and cross-task analyses remain distinct. This is not consciousness detection.

dataset.description: COGITATE-derived regional MEG data. Resolve registered Zenodo v1 against author v2 and corrected publication before fixing immutable empirical inputs.

cohort.description: Original analysis uses all 94 participants. An arbitrary smaller roster is not a same-task comparison.

split.description: Original stimulus/relevance analysis uses ten stratified participant-group folds; pinned code shuffles with random_state=127. Exact input ordering and realized membership must be reconstructed. Prospective nested folds are not interchangeable.

inputs.description: Source FC values derive from regional time series averaged by participant and event type. Preserve this condition-averaged input task and its exposure; do not relabel it as single-trial unknown-category prediction.

preprocessing.description: The source z-scores and detrends time series, screens 262 FC measures to 246, then uses the pinned feature-quality and mixed-sigmoid classifier pipeline. Changing screening or train-only scaling must be declared as a method change, with identical evaluation support.

metric.description: Accuracy at probability threshold 0.5: correct held-out predictions divided by held-out observations in each source fold. AUC and balanced accuracy are not replacement primary scores.

aggregation.description: Arithmetic mean and SD across the ten test folds for each source endpoint; region pairs, relevance and stimulus periods stay separately identified. No prospective equal-person aggregation substitution.

comparison.primary_metric: Original mean test-fold stimulus-pair accuracy, separately identified for the complete source endpoint family

published_baseline.description: Fig. 3c CS–PFC, face versus object, task-irrelevant onset: 64.3% accuracy, SD 9.4 percentage points. Fig. 3b CS–PAR face/false-font is 67.0%, SD 8.3 points. The scalar is a named anchor, not an aggregate or whole-paper victory threshold.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: No authenticated rerun. The pinned author classification route is available, but its input/supplement/version/fold join and full published endpoint mapping must be completed.

minimum_effect.rationale: Choose a justified decoding-accuracy improvement and full-family decision rule before candidate search; neither any positive delta nor stronger significance is a meaningful effect.

uncertainty.method: Predeclare paired participant-level uncertainty for matched candidate/reference predictions and multiplicity across the source endpoint family. Fold SD is descriptive and cannot supply an independent-replicate test.
uncertainty.rationale: The original groups are participants, while the endpoint family is extensive and the published best FC measures were selected across it. A paired effect requires accounting for that selection, without silently changing the source task.

paper_win_requires: Authenticate the corrected publication, exact empirical release, all 94 participants, source measure domain and realized original folds.
Retain the complete original endpoint family and freeze its comparison rule before search; success on Fig. 3c alone cannot be called surpassing the paper across its original task.
Reproduce the author baseline as calibration, then compare the frozen candidate with both the published results and authenticated author rerun on the same inputs, folds and metric support.
Keep nested participant selection, new folds, balanced accuracy, new trial-level inputs or a 262-measure domain as explicitly labelled extensions unless original-task equivalence is established.
Require the predeclared meaningful effect and valid participant-level uncertainty under fixed access and resource budgets.

current_sota.description: This contract anchors the source paper only; no separately verified present-day best method comparison is established.

episode.improvement_loop: After source admission, expose only declared training/validation feedback for method iteration within the original input condition. Log all searched measures and preprocessing choices. The existing nested proposal is an extension track.
episode.candidate_freeze: Commit candidate code, feature policy, preprocessing, endpoint family, seeds and selection rule before final scoring.
episode.final_evaluation: Replay frozen reference and candidate on identical original participant folds and complete source endpoint support; retain all per-endpoint outcomes. Existing generated examples are engineering checks only.
episode.baseline_policy: Source numerical results, authenticated author rerun and any future SOTA comparator are separately labelled. No local nested classifier becomes the published baseline.

blocking_issues: Unresolved v1/v2 empirical input and corrected-supplement identity join.
Exact original row order, participant folds, 246-measure identities and complete numeric endpoint matrix are not frozen.
No authenticated author baseline execution or protected same-task candidate evaluator.
Full-family win rule, meaningful effect, valid uncertainty and fixed feedback/compute budgets are not specified.

legacy.notes: Preserve the historical specification and nested-connectivity-v1 implementation. Its prospective folds and equal-participant balanced accuracy are explicitly an extension, not a paper-win grader.
